entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: A device crafted by Saheeli Rai to heighten Teferi's time manipulation, powered by the Weatherlight's powerstone.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Planeswalker who crafted the Temporal Anchor and repaired it.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker sent back in time through the Anchor.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who made Teferi incorporeal for his travels.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Gave Saheeli Urza's time machine designs.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer whose Sylex Blast Teferi witnessed.

entities.name: Sharaman
entities.description: Ghost of Urza's general who hindered the prototype tests.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Remained with Saheeli and Jodah to fix the machine.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Site where the Anchor was installed.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: Artifact whose detonation ended the Brothers' War era conflict in 64 AR.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose powerstone powers the Anchor.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Component that channels the Anchor's energy.

entities.name: Stasis Coffin
entities.description: Artifact confining the Anchor's pilot in stasis.

events.summary: Saheeli, Kaya and Teferi install the Anchor at Urza's Tower to send Teferi back to learn how the Sylex works; Sharaman's ghost hinders tests and is put to rest by Kaya.
events.quote: Before he was put to rest by Kaya, Sharaman severely damaged the power stabilization subsystem, though Saheeli was able to repair it.

events.summary: Teferi's first three attempts land in the wrong eras.
events.quote: Teferi first arrived amid The Dark Age , 21 years too late

events.summary: Teferi witnesses Urza setting the Sylex Blast and learns the trigger was a person.
events.quote: The trigger to detonate the Sylex was not a spell or an artifact — it was a person.

events.summary: The powerstone implodes and overloads the Anchor, leaving Teferi's consciousness lost in the time stream.
events.quote: the powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor, which left Teferi's consciousness lost in the time stream.

relations.quote: The Temporal Anchor is a device crafted by Saheeli Rai
Prototype tests were hindered by the ghost of Sharaman
